description: AI community-review research for a bottle (fetchBottleReviews). Not a user tasting-note form. iOS may have this flagged off; the tool still works. Pass bottleName, or bottleId (own collection), or username/userId + bottleId to resolve the display name then research. Returns reviews_found, msrp, general_consensus, summary, overall_rating, reviewers. Read/research only — does not write Firestore.

bottleId.description: Resolve display name from a collection doc, then research

userId.description: Firebase uid of the target user

username.description: Instadram handle (with or without @). Resolved via usernames/{handle}.

name: fetch_bottle_reviews
